sections.Profile:
"Majors of '49" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Chicago Coin Machine Manufacturing Company on February 25, 1949.

- Manufacturer: Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co.
- Years made: 1949
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wood Rail, Baseball, Sports, Original Theme
sections.Editions: - Majors of '49: 1,500 made, released 1949-02-25, model number 125
